## 2.5.7

### What's Changed
* Read subscriber identifiers with the shell uid so IMEI, IMSI and ICCID stop coming back empty by @matanbaruch in https://github.com/DeviceFarmer/STFService.apk/pull/185
* Use the natural display size in MinitouchAgent so touches land where they are aimed by @matanbaruch in https://github.com/DeviceFarmer/STFService.apk/pull/184
